description: Spreads a mono or polyphonic signal across a chosen number of polyphonic channels, in two independent sections carrying two signals each

params.text: Sets how many channels the two outputs of its section carry, from 1 to 16

inputs.text: The signal to be spread out; where it is polyphonic its channels are repeated round robin until the chosen channel count is filled

outputs.text: Carries its own input replicated into as many channels as the CHANNELS control for that section is set to; with the input unpatched it carries one channel at 0V
